arguments.prompt: Use case: precise-object-edit. Edit this adult cartoon mermaid game sprite. Image 1 is the existing drawing; image 2 is its exact original, with diagnostic red/white skin stippling. The user's correction takes precedence over the prior rendering: Turn her face slightly toward the viewer so BOTH EYES are visible, while preserving the low swimming pose, tail, hair and ripples. Give the eyes a bright amused expression and a cheerful smile above the water. Keep the head low and the rest of the body submerged; no added torso or arms. Retain her established adult identity, golden-blonde hair, turquoise hairband, tan skin and green swimwear/tail wherever already visible. Keep the current cel shading and clean dark outlines. Mood happy and playful, not sad or stoic. Keep source occlusions except the explicitly requested face adjustment. Output the whole sprite with generous padding on an actually transparent background. No checkerboard, labels, scenery, ground or extra anatomy.
